observations.behavior: Adds a new `--codeowners FILE` CLI argument to the `hogli` command, allowing the tool to write a CODEOWNERS projection of tracked test files to a specified file or stdout.
observations.posthog_connection: This enables a downstream consumer, such as Trunk Flaky Tests, to receive a CODEOWNERS-compatible ownership map without needing to read the internal `owners.yaml` or `product.yaml` files.

observations.behavior: Adds a new `cmd_codeowners` command to the CLI, which generates and optionally writes a CODEOWNERS projection of tracked test files.
observations.code_quote: @click.command(name="owners:codeowners", help="Emit a CODEOWNERS projection of test-file ownership")
observations.posthog_connection: This command generates a CODEOWNERS-compatible ownership map, which can be used by downstream consumers to attribute test files to their owners.
